items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-05-29
items.q: We have Ollie Ross and Texas Tommy in your own band.

ctx.x: Right. The trumpets were kept in the background. They're supposed to be loud instruments. Now it doesn't make any difference.
We have Ollie Ross and Texas Tommy in your own band. Are there any ones you particularly want to hear or work on?

Well the time is so short Dick. I'm sorry it was like this. I most certainly want to spend some more time. Yeah well there'll be other trips. Yeah I understand. I would like to start next time from the beginning when I started and bring up some of the incidents that happened along with the big band that I had. Even with some going back to 1926 when I first left here with Herschel Evans as an alto player. Yeah.
